title: GST rate slabs and a starter list of HSN chapter/heading rates (goods), effective 22 September 2025
scope_warning: STARTER ONLY. This is not the HSN master and must not be used to assign a rate to an item. GST rates are set by tariff item, sub-heading and heading, often with conditions (price, packaging, use); one chapter usually carries several rates. The official HSN master (about 20,000 rows) is an Excel download the founder must fetch; see README.md.

legal_basis.goods_intra_state: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate), 17 Sep 2025, effective 22 Sep 2025 (supersedes 1/2017-CT(Rate)); later amended (for example 19/2025 on tobacco products). Full text not read: PDF, founder to fetch.
legal_basis.goods_exempt: Notification No. 10/2025-Central Tax (Rate) (named on a West Bengal consolidated chart in search results; not read).
